title: Ruins of Kel'Theril

''Not to be confused with [[Kel'Thuzad]].''

[[Image:The Ruins of Kel'Theril.jpg|thumb|The Ruins of Kel'Theril]]
'''The Ruins of Kel'Theril''' are the remnants of the great [[night elven]] city of Kel'Theril. It was destroyed long ago during [[the Sundering]], and it now lies in complete ruin, haunted by the tormented spirits of the [[Highborne]] who did not survive the disaster.  The ruins lie on the edges of [[Lake Kel'Theril]] in [[Winterspring]].

There is a [[Remorseful Highborne]] here to give a quest to Alliance, seemingly she is part of the alliance herself, which is quite strange.
